title: Lazy Baked Ravioli Lasagna with Vodka Sauce & Italian Sausage
originalTitle: Lazy Baked Ravioli Lasagna with Vodka Sauce & Italian Sausage
ingredients: 2 packages (20 oz total) refrigerated or frozen cheese or spinach ravioli (no boiling needed)
1 lb sweet or hot Italian sausage, casings removed
1 jar (24 oz) creamy tomato vodka sauce
Fresh basil leaves and red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Brown the Italian sausage in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it into crumbles, then stir in the jar of vodka sauce.
Spread a thin layer of sausage vodka sauce across the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish and arrange half of the uncooked ravioli in a single layer.
Top with half the sausage vodka sauce, half the mozzarella, and half the Parmesan, then repeat with a second layer of ravioli, remaining sauce, and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake/broil 10 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden brown.
notes: Doc Note: ravioli, mozzarella, parmesan, vodka sauce, Italian sausage yum!
